neko.sketch.config.title: Neko Sketch
neko.sketch.config.pressureSensitivity: Enable pressure sensitivity for drawing tablets
neko.sketch.config.psdImportEnabled: Enable experimental PSD import. Imported PSD files are converted to native .nks layers with compatibility warnings for unsupported features.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsEnabled: Enable experimental AI operations for Neko Sketch. When disabled, Neko Sketch AI tools are not registered with neko-agent.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsGenerateEnabled: Enable the AI image generation tool when Neko Sketch AI operations are enabled.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsInpaintEnabled: Enable the AI inpaint tool when Neko Sketch AI operations are enabled.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsStyleTransferEna: Enable the AI style transfer tool when Neko Sketch AI operations are enabled.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsUpscaleEnabled: Enable the AI upscale tool when Neko Sketch AI operations are enabled.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsAutoLayerEnabled: Enable the AI auto-layer tool when Neko Sketch AI operations are enabled.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsLineartColorizeE: Enable the AI line art colorize tool when Neko Sketch AI operations are enabled.
neko.sketch.config.aiOpsSmartSelectionEn: Enable the AI smart selection tool when Neko Sketch AI operations are enabled.
neko.sketch.psdImport.disabled: PSD import is disabled by neko.sketch.psdImport.enabled.
